problem.title: You cook the food. The aggregator keeps the customer.
problem.subtitle: Every order through a delivery app costs you margin and hands over the one thing you can't buy back — the relationship with your customer.

tax.title: The aggregator tax
tax.body: 25–30% of every order vanishes in commissions. On thin restaurant margins, that's often the difference between profit and loss.

data.title: You're flying blind
data.body: The app owns the customer's name, number, and habits. You never learn who ordered, what they love, or how to bring them back.

social.title: Likes ≠ orders
social.body: Social media buys you attention, not conversion. A viral reel doesn't fill tables or move your own menu.

problem.kicker: There's a way to flip it — make the fun happen on your turf, and keep every customer you earn.

how.title: Three steps. From bored scroll to repeat order.
how.subtitle: A branded game lives on your own site. Customers play for a reward, then redeem it with you — never through a middleman.

play.title: Customer plays
play.body: They land on your branded skill-game — a quick, competitive round they actually want to replay. It lives on your menu, your domain, your brand.

win.title: Wins a reward you control
win.body: You set the prizes and the odds: a discount, a free item, bonus points. Rewards are limited and rule-based, so promos never run away from you.

order.title: Orders on YOUR site
order.body: They redeem in-store at the cashier or online with a single-use coupon code — on your channel. The margin and the data stay with you.

games.title: Two games built to be replayed.
games.subtitle: Skill-based, fast, and fully branded to your restaurant. Easy to learn, hard to put down — the replay is where retention comes from.

fruit.name: Fruit Slice
fruit.body: A satisfying slice-and-combo game. Chain fruits for multipliers, chase the weekly high score, unlock the next reward tier.

fries.name: Catch the Fries
fries.tagline: Catch the good stuff. Dodge the rest.
fries.body: A reflex catcher themed around your menu. Catch fries and signature items, avoid the traps, bank points toward prizes.

rewards.title: Everything you need to run the promo — and stay in control.
rewards.subtitle: Leaderboards, codes, limited-time offers, and prize odds you dial in yourself. Marketing that behaves like a system, not a gamble.

leaderboard.title: Weekly & monthly leaderboards
leaderboard.body: Competition brings players back on schedule. Reset weekly or monthly and reward your top regulars.

coupon.title: Single-use coupon codes
coupon.body: Every win generates a unique, single-use code — redeem in-store or online. No screenshots, no double-dipping.
coupon.hint: Tap to generate a sample code

lto.title: Limited-time offers
lto.body: Launch a weekend or holiday campaign in minutes. Set a start, an end, and let scarcity do the work.

odds.title: Controlled prize odds
odds.body: Decide exactly how often each reward appears. Protect your margin while the game still feels generous.

targeting.title: Campaigns on demand
targeting.body: Spin up themed campaigns — new-item launches, slow-day boosts, win-back offers — whenever you need them.

dashboard.title: See exactly what the game is doing for the business.
dashboard.subtitle: Plays, redemptions, returning customers, and campaign performance — in one live view. The customer data the aggregators kept from you, finally yours.

training.title: Live in a day. Your team trained.
training.subtitle: We handle setup and train your staff to redeem codes at the counter, so launch day runs smoothly and nobody at the register is guessing.

setup.title: We set it up
setup.body: Your branded game and campaigns are configured and connected to your menu — no dev work on your side.

train.title: We train your team

launch.title: You launch
launch.body: Go live the same day with a launch campaign ready to drive the first wave of plays.

items.q: Do I need my own website?
items.a: No. The game can live on a page we host for you, or embed into your existing site or ordering menu. Either way, the customer and the data stay with you.
Two ways: in-store, where your staff redeems a single-use code at the cashier; and online, where the customer applies the code at checkout on your own ordering channel.

items.q: Can I control what customers win?
items.a: Completely. You set the prize list and the exact odds for each reward, plus start and end dates for campaigns — so promos never exceed your margin.
Typically one day. We configure your game and campaigns, connect them to your menu, and train your staff to redeem codes — then you launch.

items.q: Is it hard for my staff to use?
items.a: No. Redeeming a code takes seconds at the register. We train your team and leave a simple one-page guide.
It's a monthly subscription in EGP with tiers for single locations up to multi-branch brands. See the pricing section — book a demo for exact numbers for your setup.
